name: verifier-checks
text: Verifier checks. Any failed check downgrades an item to needs_attorney with the failed check named; it never silently passes.
Original date from the source headers or metadata, never a forward, capture time or the model (V-no-source-date when none exists).
Issuer from the sender domain or page, not the display name (V-issuer-unknown).
Every quote must be an exact substring of the redacted item (V-quote-not-found).
Items not in English are kept for the attorney (V-non-english).
A candidate that fits no rule is needs_attorney (N-unmapped). Non-evidence is R-not-evidence.
